metadata.title: Apple login on Android
metadata.description: This guide provides a comprehensive walkthrough on setting up Apple Login using Capacitor for iOS devices, detailing each step to ensure a smooth integration process.

blocks.text: Apple login on android is hacky. Apple has no official support for
on Android, so the solution is slightly hacky.
Android currently uses a chrome tabs to display an OAuth2 website. This approach has the challenges:
Let me use a diagram to explain the flow on android:

props.graph:
flowchart TD
    A("await SocialLogin.login()") -->|Handled in the plugin|B(Generate the login URL)
    B --> |Pass the link| C(Open the Chrome browser)
    C --> D(Wait for the user to login)
    D --> |Apple redirects to your backend|E(Handle the data returned from Apple)
    E --> F(Redirect back to the app)
    F --> G(Return to JS)
props.ariaLabel: Apple Login flow diagram on Android
